defs.meaning: （引出第二种选择或可能的建议）要不，或者

examples.en: You could, alternatively, hang onto it in the hope that it will be worth millions in 10 years time.
examples.zh: 或者，你也可以把它留着，指望它10年后值好几百万。

examples.en: The agency will make travel arrangements for you. Alternatively, you can organize your own transport.
examples.zh: 旅行社将为你安排旅行，或者你也可以自己安排交通工具。

examples.en: Hotels are generally of a good standard and not too expensive. Alternatively you could stay in an apartment.
examples.zh: 旅馆一般标准高并且不太贵。或者你可以住公寓。
